text: Milking robot stall 4 keeps mis-logging cows; need the ear-tag numbers read off the stall snapshots with top accuracy, no slips on digits. Process it here on the farm's own box, nothing goes off-premises, and put it at the front of the queue. Delete each snapshot the moment the tag is read.
